Name: Content Patcher - Kat's Elliott Portrait
Author: KatJustice97
Description:
I have always hated Elliott's portraits. He's so orange and they're drawn in such an unforgiving angle. None of the existing portraits I could find really fixed that enough for my taste, so I used Poltergeister & Jaz's Character Creator to create a base and modified it until I was happy, and figured I might as well share since I'm pretty proud of them. I eventually plan to add seasonal outfits, and I'll update it with a config file (which should also be compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]) when I do to enable or disable at will, so stay tuned for that if you're interested. [s]I'll probably change the sprites too at some point.

[/s]I've added sprites! As well as an optional cartoon-y visual effects overlay on certain portraits. It defaults to false, but can be toggled via config.json or GMCM. I'll continue daydreaming about seasonal outfits. That one might take a bit longer.
